A man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, first mentioned at Num.1.8; 
father of: Nethanel (H5417) 
§ Zuar = "littleness"
father of Nethaneel, the chief of the tribe of Issachar at the time of the exodus and an assistant of Moses

A man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, only mentioned at Num.25.15; 
father of: Cozbi (H3579)
§ Zur = "rock"
1) father of Cozbi and one of the 5 Midianite princes who were slain when Balaam fell
2) son of Jehiel, the father or leader of Gibeon
